occurrences.text: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
